channel.title: Omni View - Balanced News Perspectives (Русский)
channel.description: Daily world news where every story is presented from the strongest case each side can make — the version its most thoughtful advocates actually argue, never a caricature. Sources attributed, both sides steel-manned, so you decide. You shouldn't be able to tell which side we favor.
